Tests that a request is rejected when budget is exceeded

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  client = LiterLlm.create_client_from_json('{"api_key":"your-api-key","budget":{"enforcement":"hard","global_limit":0.0}}')
  result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
